hold_reason: review: Google: The definition 'Offboarding कर्मचारी प्रक्रिया है' is too vague; it refers to the process of terminating an employee or user access.
objections: Google: The definition 'Offboarding कर्मचारी प्रक्रिया है' is too vague; it refers to the process of terminating an employee or user access.

Alibaba: The Hindi meaning 'Offboarding कर्मचारी प्रक्रिया है' (Offboarding is an employee process) is tautological and lacks descriptive value. It should explain it as the process of removing access/permissions or transitioning a user out.
